{{Quote|Announce yourself first when you come into my office.|Jagged Fel, after Jaina Solo bursts into his office|<ref name="Allies" />}}
The '''Offices of the Imperial Head of State''', also known as the '''Residence''' and '''Quarters of the Galactic Empire Head of State''', were a series of luxuriously-decorated offices used by [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]] during his stays on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. He used the offices for work, as well as to relax from the pressures of [[Politics/Legends|politics]].

==Description==
The Offices of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]],<ref name="Allies" /> also known as the Quarters of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] Head of State or the Residence of the Galactic Empire Head of State,<ref name="Conviction">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]''</ref> were located in the [[Galactic Empire Embassy]] Complex on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. The offices were furnished with dark, expensive, luxurious items, including a [[Nerf-hide/Legends|nerf-hide]] chair, a [[Viewscreen/Legends|vidscreen]],<ref name="Allies" /> and a [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Leather/Legends|leather]] [[Couch/Legends|sofa]]. Various personal [[Aide/Legends|aides]] for [[Jagged Fel]], the Imperial Head of State in [[44 ABY]], were stationed in the outer offices in case he needed them.<ref name="Conviction" />

[[File:JaggedFel-NEGTC.png|thumb|right|150px|Imperial Head of State Jagged Fel]]

==History==
{{Quote|Jedi Solo to see you.''"<br />"''Tell her that I expected her six seconds ago. Then let her in.|The Head of State's secretary and Jagged Fel|<ref name="Conviction" />}}
The Offices of the Imperial Head of State were used by Head of State Jagged Fel in 44 ABY, three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Uroro Station|end]] of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. Fel was irked by beings who barged into his office without asking, as the offices alternatively served as a place where he worked,<ref name="Allies" /> kept updated on the news,<ref name="Conviction" /> and relaxed from the pressures of [[Politics/Legends|politics]]. He had a [[Jagged Fel's secretary|secretary]] in the outer offices who served as a greeter to visitors and notified him when people arrived to see him, and he received frequent visits from his [[Marriage/Legends|fiancée]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]]. It was during one such visit that Solo saw that their separate careers were getting in the way of their relationship, and she called off their engagement,<ref name="Allies" /> although they later became re-engaged. Fel's quarters then served as an intimate meeting area where he and Solo could escape from their troubles.<ref name="Conviction" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Offices of the Imperial Head of State first appeared in the fifth novel in the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series, ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]'', written by [[Christie Golden]] and published in [[2010]].<ref name="Allies" /> They were mentioned again in the seventh ''Fate of the Jedi'' novel, ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]''&mdash;written by [[Aaron Allston]] and published in [[2011]]&mdash;as the "Quarters of the Galactic Empire Head of State" and the "Residence of the Galactic Empire Head of State."<ref name="Conviction" />
